prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single objectively “best” marketing agency for all businesses in Maryland — the right agency depends on your goals, budget, industry, and preferred working style. I can recommend specific agencies, but first I need a few details so I can tailor recommendations.

Quick questions
- What kind of marketing do you need? (digital ads, SEO, social media, content, brand, PR, web design, B2B, B2C, etc.)
- What’s your monthly/annual budget range?
- What industry are you in?
- Do you prefer a local Maryland agency (in Baltimore/Annapolis area) or is remote/national okay?
- What’s your timeline and primary goal (lead gen, sales, awareness, hiring, fundraising)?

How to pick the “best” agency (use this checklist when evaluating)
- Relevant experience: case studies and results in your industry or with similar goals.
- Clear KPIs and measurement: how they will track ROI and report progress.
- Team & capacity: who will actually do the work and how experienced are they?
- Services and strategy fit: do they offer the exact services you need (vs. trying to upsell everything)?
- Transparency and communication: reporting cadence, dashboards, points of contact.
- Pricing and contract terms: monthly retainer, project fees, minimum terms, cancellation.
- References and reviews: talk to current/past clients about results and working relationship.
- Creative & technical quality: review their portfolio and live work (ads, websites, content).
- Cultural fit: responsiveness, tone, and approach that match your organization.

Questions to ask any agency you interview
- Can you show 2–3 case studies with measurable outcomes?
- Who will be our day-to-day contact and what does the team look like?
- What are the first 90 days of work and expected milestones?
- How do you measure success for this type of campaign?
- What reporting will we receive and how often?
- What are your fees and contract terms? Any additional costs?

Common red flags
- No clear metrics or case studies.
- Vague pricing or hidden fees.
- Promises of guaranteed #1 rankings or unrealistic ROI.
- Long-term lock-in without exit clauses.
- Poor communication during initial conversations.

If you want, tell me the answers to the quick questions above and I’ll produce a short, vetted list of Maryland agencies (and why each might fit your needs), plus an outreach/email template you can use to start conversations.
